symptom: Storyboard T2I produced duplicate portraits for a hand insert and implausible infant scale in a shoulder close-up.
root_cause: Long parent-and-baby descriptions compete with the requested crop; composition and subject scale were ambiguous.
fix: Rewrite inserts without adult identity essays; explicitly crop faces. Simplify infant interaction. Qwen local edit corrected the infant hand; preserve all draft versions.
prevention: Inspect each frame. Use body-part-only prompts for inserts, explicit contact and scale, then local repair. Storyboard acceptance is not production keyframe approval.
